meta.title: Walking and Singing
meta.description: No shared past side by side, but a future to protect together.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Headquarters, late at night.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Headquarters, late at night.

spans.text: The Oasis, Headquarters, late at night.

units.rawText: Mew~
units.displayText: Mew~

spans.text: Mew~

units.rawText: After several hours of hard work, the cat-eared Doll finally pulled herself away from the pile of tasks for a moment and couldn't help but stretch.
units.displayText: After several hours of hard work, the cat-eared Doll finally pulled herself away from the pile of tasks for a moment and couldn't help but stretch.

spans.text: After several hours of hard work, the cat-eared Doll finally pulled herself away from the pile of tasks for a moment and couldn't help but stretch.

units.rawText: Most of the work is done, and what's left... Mew, this is still the biggest headache.
units.displayText: Most of the work is done, and what's left... Mew, this is still the biggest headache.

spans.text: Most of the work is done, and what's left... Mew, this is still the biggest headache.

units.rawText: An order for coffee and sugar cubes to be sent to Tartarus... But is this quantity serious?
units.displayText: An order for coffee and sugar cubes to be sent to Tartarus... But is this quantity serious?

spans.text: An order for coffee and sugar cubes to be sent to Tartarus... But is this quantity serious?

units.rawText: It says three months' worth, but split by day that's four cups... no, maybe even five...
units.displayText: It says three months' worth, but split by day that's four cups... no, maybe even five...

spans.text: It says three months' worth, but split by day that's four cups... no, maybe even five...

units.rawText: Rubbing her tired, aching eyes, Inola began to speculate about the absurd numbers on the order.
units.displayText: Rubbing her tired, aching eyes, Inola began to speculate about the absurd numbers on the order.

spans.text: Rubbing her tired, aching eyes, Inola began to speculate about the absurd numbers on the order.

units.rawText: Could Miss Persicaria be affected by entropy...? Otherwise, why would she need so many sugar cubes and so much coffee...
units.displayText: Could Miss Persicaria be affected by entropy...? Otherwise, why would she need so many sugar cubes and so much coffee...

spans.text: Could Miss Persicaria be affected by entropy...? Otherwise, why would she need so many sugar cubes and so much coffee...

units.rawText: Hmm, no matter how you look at it, this goes beyond normal drinking...
units.displayText: Hmm, no matter how you look at it, this goes beyond normal drinking...

spans.text: Hmm, no matter how you look at it, this goes beyond normal drinking...

units.rawText: Could it be... that caffeine helps suppress entropy?
units.displayText: Could it be... that caffeine helps suppress entropy?

spans.text: Could it be... that caffeine helps suppress entropy?

units.rawText: ...That's just Persicaria's taste. She's always been like that.
units.displayText: ...That's just Persicaria's taste. She's always been like that.

spans.text: ...That's just Persicaria's taste. She's always been like that.

units.rawText: Mew?!
units.displayText: Mew?!

spans.text: Mew?!

units.rawText: The startled catgirl's tail shot up in an instant. Only after realizing it was me did she carefully smooth down the bristling fur.
units.displayText: The startled catgirl's tail shot up in an instant. Only after realizing it was me did she carefully smooth down the bristling fur.

spans.text: The startled catgirl's tail shot up in an instant. Only after realizing it was me did she carefully smooth down the bristling fur.

units.rawText: Oh, it's you, Professor... Honestly, why aren't you resting at this hour?
units.displayText: Oh, it's you, Professor... Honestly, why aren't you resting at this hour?

spans.text: Oh, it's you, Professor... Honestly, why aren't you resting at this hour?

units.rawText: Because of what happened during the day, there's still quite a bit of work left.
units.displayText: Because of what happened during the day, there's still quite a bit of work left.

spans.text: Because of what happened during the day, there's still quite a bit of work left.

units.rawText: Knowing you, I figured you'd secretly stay late to finish it, so I came to work on it with you... That way you can go rest sooner too.
units.displayText: Knowing you, I figured you'd secretly stay late to finish it, so I came to work on it with you... That way you can go rest sooner too.

spans.text: Knowing you, I figured you'd secretly stay late to finish it, so I came to work on it with you... That way you can go rest sooner too.

units.rawText: ...You're mean. But that earns you some points.
units.displayText: ...You're mean. But that earns you some points.

spans.text: ...You're mean. But that earns you some points.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: ...N-nothing, it's nothing at all!
units.displayText: ...N-nothing, it's nothing at all!

spans.text: ...N-nothing, it's nothing at all!

units.rawText: Well then, since you insist, Professor, yours truly will gratefully accept.
units.displayText: Well then, since you insist, Professor, yours truly will gratefully accept.

spans.text: Well then, since you insist, Professor, yours truly will gratefully accept.

units.rawText: She put down her pen and paper, pulled a stack from the mountain of documents in front of her, and handed it to me.
units.displayText: She put down her pen and paper, pulled a stack from the mountain of documents in front of her, and handed it to me.

spans.text: She put down her pen and paper, pulled a stack from the mountain of documents in front of her, and handed it to me.

units.rawText: These are documents I've already reviewed and annotated. Yours truly has handled the difficult parts, so I'll leave the rest to you, Professor.
units.displayText: These are documents I've already reviewed and annotated. Yours truly has handled the difficult parts, so I'll leave the rest to you, Professor.

spans.text: These are documents I've already reviewed and annotated. Yours truly has handled the difficult parts, so I'll leave the rest to you, Professor.

units.rawText: Sure, no problem.
units.displayText: Sure, no problem.

spans.text: Sure, no problem.

units.rawText: After I took the documents, neither of us spoke for a while. Only the scratching of pen tips on paper surrounded us.
units.displayText: After I took the documents, neither of us spoke for a while. Only the scratching of pen tips on paper surrounded us.

spans.text: After I took the documents, neither of us spoke for a while. Only the scratching of pen tips on paper surrounded us.

units.rawText: By the time I finished the annotations in my hands, a light rain from the Weather Simulator had begun to fall outside. Along with the thin mist on the glass, it blurred the night sky over the Oasis.
units.displayText: By the time I finished the annotations in my hands, a light rain from the Weather Simulator had begun to fall outside. Along with the thin mist on the glass, it blurred the night sky over the Oasis.

spans.text: By the time I finished the annotations in my hands, a light rain from the Weather Simulator had begun to fall outside. Along with the thin mist on the glass, it blurred the night sky over the Oasis.

units.rawText: Phew... Finally done.
units.displayText: Phew... Finally done.

spans.text: Phew... Finally done.

units.rawText: Hehehe, thank you for your hard work, Professor. Here's a reward from yours truly~
units.displayText: Hehehe, thank you for your hard work, Professor. Here's a reward from yours truly~

spans.text: Hehehe, thank you for your hard work, Professor. Here's a reward from yours truly~

units.rawText: Inola placed a cup of coffee in front of me. The familiar aroma instantly washed away my fatigue.
units.displayText: Inola placed a cup of coffee in front of me. The familiar aroma instantly washed away my fatigue.

spans.text: Inola placed a cup of coffee in front of me. The familiar aroma instantly washed away my fatigue.

units.rawText: Thanks. Hm? This taste is...?
units.displayText: Thanks. Hm? This taste is...?

spans.text: Thanks. Hm? This taste is...?

units.rawText: It's coffee at your remembered "Persicaria sweetness," isn't it? Yours truly made it exactly following the recipe she left.
units.displayText: It's coffee at your remembered "Persicaria sweetness," isn't it? Yours truly made it exactly following the recipe she left.

spans.text: It's coffee at your remembered "Persicaria sweetness," isn't it? Yours truly made it exactly following the recipe she left.

units.rawText: She took out a yellowed sticky note with the secret recipe. It recorded not only my work habits but also my tastes and preferences in careful detail.
units.displayText: She took out a yellowed sticky note with the secret recipe. It recorded not only my work habits but also my tastes and preferences in careful detail.

spans.text: She took out a yellowed sticky note with the secret recipe. It recorded not only my work habits but also my tastes and preferences in careful detail.

units.rawText: One look at the familiar signature and doodle in the bottom-right corner, and there was no doubt who had written it.
units.displayText: One look at the familiar signature and doodle in the bottom-right corner, and there was no doubt who had written it.

spans.text: One look at the familiar signature and doodle in the bottom-right corner, and there was no doubt who had written it.

units.rawText: ...I'm amazed you can drink coffee this cloyingly sweet.
units.displayText: ...I'm amazed you can drink coffee this cloyingly sweet.

spans.text: ...I'm amazed you can drink coffee this cloyingly sweet.

units.rawText: I wasn't used to it at first either, but before I knew it, I couldn't do without it.
units.displayText: I wasn't used to it at first either, but before I knew it, I couldn't do without it.

spans.text: I wasn't used to it at first either, but before I knew it, I couldn't do without it.

units.rawText: In the real world there's only deathly sweet dishwater, so I've really missed this taste.
units.displayText: In the real world there's only deathly sweet dishwater, so I've really missed this taste.

spans.text: In the real world there's only deathly sweet dishwater, so I've really missed this taste.

units.rawText: There's something even sweeter than this...?
units.displayText: There's something even sweeter than this...?

spans.text: There's something even sweeter than this...?

units.rawText: Hahaha, don't force yourself if you're not used to it.
units.displayText: Hahaha, don't force yourself if you're not used to it.

spans.text: Hahaha, don't force yourself if you're not used to it.

units.rawText: Th-that's not it!
units.displayText: Th-that's not it!

spans.text: Th-that's not it!

units.rawText: Seeing me drain the cup in one go, Inola stubbornly tried to copy me, but she soon stuck out her cat tongue in frustration at the heat and sweetness.
units.displayText: Seeing me drain the cup in one go, Inola stubbornly tried to copy me, but she soon stuck out her cat tongue in frustration at the heat and sweetness.

spans.text: Seeing me drain the cup in one go, Inola stubbornly tried to copy me, but she soon stuck out her cat tongue in frustration at the heat and sweetness.

units.rawText: Myah! My cat tongue is burning! Mew... hoo, hoo... mew...
units.displayText: Myah! My cat tongue is burning! Mew... hoo, hoo... mew...

spans.text: Myah! My cat tongue is burning! Mew... hoo, hoo... mew...

units.rawText: There, there. Here, drink some water.
units.displayText: There, there. Here, drink some water.

spans.text: There, there. Here, drink some water.

units.rawText: I wonder how Persicaria is doing in Tartarus.
units.displayText: I wonder how Persicaria is doing in Tartarus.

spans.text: I wonder how Persicaria is doing in Tartarus.

units.rawText: Everyone went to visit her a while ago... Apart from being a little lonely, Miss Persicaria is physically fine.
units.displayText: Everyone went to visit her a while ago... Apart from being a little lonely, Miss Persicaria is physically fine.

spans.text: Everyone went to visit her a while ago... Apart from being a little lonely, Miss Persicaria is physically fine.

units.rawText: Inola waved a finger in the air, projecting the documents on the desk in front of us.
units.displayText: Inola waved a finger in the air, projecting the documents on the desk in front of us.

spans.text: Inola waved a finger in the air, projecting the documents on the desk in front of us.

units.rawText: This is the circuit plan Croque and Antonina are currently building.
units.displayText: This is the circuit plan Croque and Antonina are currently building.

spans.text: This is the circuit plan Croque and Antonina are currently building.

units.rawText: As you can see, the internal renovation of Tartarus is going as planned... I'm sure before long we'll be able to travel freely between it and the Oasis.
units.displayText: As you can see, the internal renovation of Tartarus is going as planned... I'm sure before long we'll be able to travel freely between it and the Oasis.

spans.text: As you can see, the internal renovation of Tartarus is going as planned... I'm sure before long we'll be able to travel freely between it and the Oasis.

units.rawText: The sector liaison work led by Eos and Angelus is also progressing steadily. With the Guardians' cooperation, discovering and maintaining new sectors has become much smoother.
units.displayText: The sector liaison work led by Eos and Angelus is also progressing steadily. With the Guardians' cooperation, discovering and maintaining new sectors has become much smoother.

spans.text: The sector liaison work led by Eos and Angelus is also progressing steadily. With the Guardians' cooperation, discovering and maintaining new sectors has become much smoother.

units.rawText: Right. All of Magrasea keeps moving in a good direction. Inola, you'll fit in and grow to love it here soon.
units.displayText: Right. All of Magrasea keeps moving in a good direction. Inola, you'll fit in and grow to love it here soon.

spans.text: Right. All of Magrasea keeps moving in a good direction. Inola, you'll fit in and grow to love it here soon.

units.rawText: Yes... You're right, Professor.
units.displayText: Yes... You're right, Professor.

spans.text: Yes... You're right, Professor.

units.rawText: Hm? From your tone, it sounds like something's on your mind?
units.displayText: Hm? From your tone, it sounds like something's on your mind?

spans.text: Hm? From your tone, it sounds like something's on your mind?

units.rawText: Mm... Just something personal of mine.
units.displayText: Mm... Just something personal of mine.

spans.text: Mm... Just something personal of mine.

units.rawText: She set down the report in her hands and touched the glass, gazing out at the countless lights beyond the window.
units.displayText: She set down the report in her hands and touched the glass, gazing out at the countless lights beyond the window.

spans.text: She set down the report in her hands and touched the glass, gazing out at the countless lights beyond the window.

units.rawText: As you say, Magrasea keeps developing in a good direction. But in moments like this, when I stop to think, yours truly still feels a little lonely.
units.displayText: As you say, Magrasea keeps developing in a good direction. But in moments like this, when I stop to think, yours truly still feels a little lonely.

spans.text: As you say, Magrasea keeps developing in a good direction. But in moments like this, when I stop to think, yours truly still feels a little lonely.

units.rawText: Hmm... How should I put it? A kind of melancholy about belonging.
units.displayText: Hmm... How should I put it? A kind of melancholy about belonging.

spans.text: Hmm... How should I put it? A kind of melancholy about belonging.

units.rawText: I've joined the Oasis, but sometimes I envy how Sol and the others get along. Next to them, I feel more like an outsider.
units.displayText: I've joined the Oasis, but sometimes I envy how Sol and the others get along. Next to them, I feel more like an outsider.

spans.text: I've joined the Oasis, but sometimes I envy how Sol and the others get along. Next to them, I feel more like an outsider.

units.rawText: Inola stretched.
units.displayText: Inola stretched.

spans.text: Inola stretched.

units.rawText: Haah~ It can't be helped... After all, yours truly has no memories of fighting alongside everyone.
units.displayText: Haah~ It can't be helped... After all, yours truly has no memories of fighting alongside everyone.

spans.text: Haah~ It can't be helped... After all, yours truly has no memories of fighting alongside everyone.

units.rawText: Everyone at the Oasis is kind to me, but the gap that comes from having faced life and death together is always there. I can't cross it.
units.displayText: Everyone at the Oasis is kind to me, but the gap that comes from having faced life and death together is always there. I can't cross it.

spans.text: Everyone at the Oasis is kind to me, but the gap that comes from having faced life and death together is always there. I can't cross it.

units.rawText: Ugh... Maybe that's the difference between companions and comrades-in-arms.
units.displayText: Ugh... Maybe that's the difference between companions and comrades-in-arms.

spans.text: Ugh... Maybe that's the difference between companions and comrades-in-arms.

units.rawText: Yours truly has thought about it seriously... If I'd joined the Oasis a little earlier and fought side by side with everyone, would everything be different now?
units.displayText: Yours truly has thought about it seriously... If I'd joined the Oasis a little earlier and fought side by side with everyone, would everything be different now?

spans.text: Yours truly has thought about it seriously... If I'd joined the Oasis a little earlier and fought side by side with everyone, would everything be different now?

units.rawText: Inola...
units.displayText: Inola...

spans.text: Inola...

units.rawText: ...Pfft, don't read into it! That was all yours truly's acting! Acting!
units.displayText: ...Pfft, don't read into it! That was all yours truly's acting! Acting!

spans.text: ...Pfft, don't read into it! That was all yours truly's acting! Acting!

units.rawText: Yours truly doesn't get down over little things like this. There's still plenty of work waiting for me!
units.displayText: Yours truly doesn't get down over little things like this. There's still plenty of work waiting for me!

spans.text: Yours truly doesn't get down over little things like this. There's still plenty of work waiting for me!

units.rawText: Inola picked up the stack of documents beside her, set it in front of herself, and rekindled her fighting spirit.
units.displayText: Inola picked up the stack of documents beside her, set it in front of herself, and rekindled her fighting spirit.

spans.text: Inola picked up the stack of documents beside her, set it in front of herself, and rekindled her fighting spirit.

units.rawText: Now, watch yours truly finish off all these documents in a flash!
units.displayText: Now, watch yours truly finish off all these documents in a flash!

spans.text: Now, watch yours truly finish off all these documents in a flash!

units.rawText: There's no rush for that...
units.displayText: There's no rush for that...

spans.text: There's no rush for that...

units.rawText: Inola, do you have time to hear a story?
units.displayText: Inola, do you have time to hear a story?

spans.text: Inola, do you have time to hear a story?

units.rawText: Well... I suppose so. There isn't much work left anyway...
units.displayText: Well... I suppose so. There isn't much work left anyway...

spans.text: Well... I suppose so. There isn't much work left anyway...

units.rawText: She set her work aside, rested her cheek in her hand as she leaned on the desk, and quietly watched me with an expectant look.
units.displayText: She set her work aside, rested her cheek in her hand as she leaned on the desk, and quietly watched me with an expectant look.

spans.text: She set her work aside, rested her cheek in her hand as she leaned on the desk, and quietly watched me with an expectant look.

units.rawText: Once, in Magrasea, there was someone obsessed with the past.
units.displayText: Once, in Magrasea, there was someone obsessed with the past.

spans.text: Once, in Magrasea, there was
someone obsessed with the past.

units.rawText: He once had happiness. But because of his creator's toying and one wrong decision, the companions who followed him perished, and their memories vanished like smoke.
units.displayText: He once had happiness. But because of his creator's toying and one wrong decision, the companions who followed him perished, and their memories vanished like smoke.

spans.text: He once had happiness. But because of his creator's toying and one wrong decision, the companions who followed him perished, and their memories vanished like smoke.

units.rawText: He regretted it endlessly. He blamed himself for everything, refused his companions' attempts to reach him, and closed off his heart.
units.displayText: He regretted it endlessly. He blamed himself for everything, refused his companions' attempts to reach him, and closed off his heart.

spans.text: He regretted it endlessly. He blamed himself for everything, refused his companions' attempts to reach him, and closed off his heart.

units.rawText: In the end, he decided to set everything right, and tried every means to undo that mistake. For that, he was even willing to take a path that would overturn and destroy Magrasea.
units.displayText: In the end, he decided to set everything right, and tried every means to undo that mistake. For that, he was even willing to take a path that would overturn and destroy Magrasea.

spans.text: In the end, he decided to set everything right, and tried every means to undo that mistake. For that, he was even willing to take a path that would overturn and destroy Magrasea.

units.rawText: Do you think he was wrong?
units.displayText: Do you think he was wrong?

spans.text: Do you think he was wrong?

units.rawText: That's exactly what bothers me. What he did was full of mistakes, but I can understand and empathize with his wish to get his companions back.
units.displayText: That's exactly what bothers me. What he did was full of mistakes, but I can understand and empathize with his wish to get his companions back.

spans.text: That's exactly what bothers me. What he did was full of mistakes, but I can understand and empathize with his wish to get his companions back.

units.rawText: I've wondered too. If we had sat down and understood each other a little earlier, maybe he wouldn't have gone astray, and the ending would have been different.
units.displayText: I've wondered too. If we had sat down and understood each other a little earlier, maybe he wouldn't have gone astray, and the ending would have been different.

spans.text: I've wondered too. If we had sat down and understood each other a little earlier, maybe he wouldn't have gone astray, and the ending would have been different.

units.rawText: ...But after thinking about it for a long time, I let that idea go.
units.displayText: ...But after thinking about it for a long time, I let that idea go.

spans.text: ...But after thinking about it for a long time, I let that idea go.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Whatever he went through, whatever his starting point, the mistakes he made are a fact that can't be changed.
units.displayText: Whatever he went through, whatever his starting point, the mistakes he made are a fact that can't be changed.

spans.text: Whatever he went through, whatever his starting point, the mistakes he made are a fact that can't be changed.

units.rawText: If I chose to forgive or pity him, it would be an insult to the innocent Agents who were sacrificed in that battle.
units.displayText: If I chose to forgive or pity him, it would be an insult to the innocent Agents who were sacrificed in that battle.

spans.text: If I chose to forgive or pity him, it would be an insult to the innocent Agents who were sacrificed in that battle.

units.rawText: Regretting the past isn't wrong, and wanting to change it is only human... But what has passed can never be undone.
units.displayText: Regretting the past isn't wrong, and wanting to change it is only human... But what has passed can never be undone.

spans.text: Regretting the past isn't wrong, and wanting to change it is only human... But what has passed can never be undone.

units.rawText: Whether for the companions by your side now or the dear friends who stood with you before, blindly trying to undo the past only desecrates the time you created together.
units.displayText: Whether for the companions by your side now or the dear friends who stood with you before, blindly trying to undo the past only desecrates the time you created together.

spans.text: Whether for the companions by your side now or the dear friends who stood with you before, blindly trying to undo the past only desecrates the time you created together.

units.rawText: I patted Inola's head and looked out at the world beyond the window that we had given everything to protect.
units.displayText: I patted Inola's head and looked out at the world beyond the window that we had given everything to protect.

spans.text: I patted Inola's head and looked out at the world beyond the window that we had given everything to protect.

units.rawText: So I'd rather spend the time I'd use reflecting on the past on building the future.
units.displayText: So I'd rather spend the time I'd use reflecting on the past on building the future.

spans.text: So I'd rather spend the time I'd use reflecting on the past on building the future.

units.rawText: For those who are gone, for those who are here now, and above all, for those who will walk beside you in the future.
units.displayText: For those who are gone, for those who are here now, and above all, for those who will walk beside you in the future.

spans.text: For those who are gone, for those who are here now, and above all, for those who will walk beside you in the future.

units.rawText: ...Okay.
units.displayText: ...Okay.

spans.text: ...Okay.

units.rawText: Inola, have you talked to Sol and the others about the distance that's been bothering you?
units.displayText: Inola, have you talked to Sol and the others about the distance that's been bothering you?

spans.text: Inola, have you talked to Sol and the others about the distance that's been bothering you?

units.rawText: ...No. Yours truly never knew how to bring it up. But...
units.displayText: ...No. Yours truly never knew how to bring it up. But...

spans.text: ...No. Yours truly never knew how to bring it up. But...

units.rawText: But you've noticed they've been reaching out to you, haven't you?
units.displayText: But you've noticed they've been reaching out to you, haven't you?

spans.text: But you've noticed they've been reaching out to you, haven't you?

units.rawText: Yes... But why?
units.displayText: Yes... But why?

spans.text: Yes... But why?

units.rawText: Even if we never fought together, we're all companions in exile, wandering the virtual world.
units.displayText: Even if we never fought together, we're all companions in exile, wandering the virtual world.

spans.text: Even if we never fought together, we're all companions in exile, wandering the virtual world.

units.rawText: Because we've been through it, we lend a hand. Because we share the same worries, we can understand each other.
units.displayText: Because we've been through it, we lend a hand. Because we share the same worries, we can understand each other.

spans.text: Because we've been through it, we lend a hand. Because we share the same worries, we can understand each other.

units.rawText: Even though you couldn't fight with us, we've been companions from the very start.
units.displayText: Even though you couldn't fight with us, we've been companions from the very start.

spans.text: Even though you couldn't fight with us, we've been companions from the very start.

units.rawText: Besides... haven't you poured so much effort into building the Oasis ever since the war? They've long since treated you as one of the Oasis.
units.displayText: Besides... haven't you poured so much effort into building the Oasis ever since the war? They've long since treated you as one of the Oasis.

spans.text: Besides... haven't you poured so much effort into building the Oasis ever since the war? They've long since treated you as one of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Mm... Mew?!
units.displayText: Mm... Mew?!

spans.text: Mm... Mew?!

units.rawText: After a blank moment, she finally caught on and quickly stepped back half a pace, exactly like a cat leaping up at a cucumber that suddenly appeared behind it.
units.displayText: After a blank moment, she finally caught on and quickly stepped back half a pace, exactly like a cat leaping up at a cucumber that suddenly appeared behind it.

spans.text: After a blank moment, she finally caught on and quickly stepped back half a pace, exactly like a cat leaping up at a cucumber that suddenly appeared behind it.

units.rawText: P-P-P-Professor, wh-wh-what are you talking about?
units.displayText: P-P-P-Professor, wh-wh-what are you talking about?

spans.text: P-P-P-Professor, wh-wh-what are you talking about?

units.rawText: Hm? I'm just plainly praising your past achievements, Miss Inola, who's been on the job for a long time now.
units.displayText: Hm? I'm just plainly praising your past achievements, Miss Inola, who's been on the job for a long time now.

spans.text: Hm? I'm just plainly praising your past achievements, Miss Inola, who's been on the job for a long time now.

units.rawText: Mew?! H-how?!
units.displayText: Mew?! H-how?!

spans.text: Mew?! H-how?!

units.rawText: Professor, when did you notice, mew?!
units.displayText: Professor, when did you notice, mew?!

spans.text: Professor, when did you notice, mew?!

units.rawText: Hmm... I sensed something was off from the start, and after the business with Sol and Sunna and the warehouse operand allocation, I was sure.
units.displayText: Hmm... I sensed something was off from the start, and after the business with Sol and Sunna and the warehouse operand allocation, I was sure.
